tools.name: get_resolution
tools.description: Returns the full detail for one action in the bank of 30: its life area and feeling, the first move for week one, the resolution at all three time levels (30 minutes, 2 hours, and 5 hours a week), the guard line for each kind of past failure, and up to 3 similar actions. Accepts an action id or name
